Location, great building, beautiful art, very nice rooms. The breakfast service was consistently a disaster throughout our stay. The restaurant was clearly understaffed and every morning there seemed to be a new series of mistakes. Coffee regularly arrived cold, orders were taken incorrectly, dishes were forgotten, and food for the same table would arrive at completely different times. On several occasions someone in our party had to leave for a meeting before their food even arrived. For a hotel of this calibre the breakfast operation was surprisingly poor and needs serious attention. * 3 nights · July 2026 * Couple
Professionals, very warm and caring staff, excellent service. * 4 nights · August 2026 * Couple

Service, staff and the location are magnificent. * 3 nights · June 2026 * Couple
Excellent location and quality of the accommodation in general. Little support space in the bathroom. * 4 nights · July 2026 * Solo traveller

Room was not ready despite arriving at 11pm, the reason given was that I booked last minute. The front desk staff had attitude and was driven by trying to upsell an upgrade rather than resolving the situation. Despite the upgrade the room I received was the smallest I have stayed in at this brand, and the first room shown had no proper windows. There was a leftover picture frame from the couple before left in the room, and a hair comb left in the bathroom. Raises serious concerns around hygiene and cleanliness. Raised to the manager who gave a small refund of under five per cent of total cost, which does not address the issue properly. * 1 night · July 2026 * Group
Atmosphere and appearance. * 3 nights · June 2026 * Couple

Everything was up to a very high standard, the room was spotless, comfortable and beautifully maintained. The facilities were excellent and we enjoyed both a massage and a facial at the spa. They allowed us to use the spa facilities on our departure day even after checkout. We were charged for a breakfast that we never had. Although the charge was removed from our bill during checkout, it was still charged to our credit card afterward. We have emailed the hotel several times about the issue but have not received a response. * 3 nights · July 2026 * Couple

We had booked two junior suites with canal view. One room was fine on one level but the other was very small and on two levels with steep stairs, which did not match the price. Our room was double booked, another guest had a key to our room. Consistently poor service at the hotel. Check-in took 30 minutes. It took 45 minutes to get breakfast in the dining room on three of four visits. Dry cleaning stated express as 34 hours versus the 4 stated on drop-off. * 2 nights · June 2026 * Couple
Beautiful property, exceptional service. * 3 nights · June 2026 * Couple

Amazing location, a beautiful building and well designed interior that feels premium. The staff are professional and cheerful. Great luxury spa. The hotel is very new and shows no signs of wear. The housekeeping needs some work. The room was not cleaned once and we had to bring this up with reception twice, and toiletries and tea were not restocked one day. * 4 nights · June 2026 * Couple

The location is excellent and it is housed in a magnificent historic building. The spa facilities and indoor pool are the highlights. Breakfast service was chaotic. After waiting for an hour I gave up, as I could not even get a glass of water. The staff showed a lack of coordination and professionalism. The quality of the room was below expectations and the interior view created a claustrophobic feeling. The gym is extremely small, which does not align with the hotel category. * 4 nights · June 2026 * Couple
Location, friendly staff, amazing service. * 2 nights · June 2026 * Couple

The hotel was great, new, clean and of high quality. The hotel restaurant has good food but catastrophic service. We waited a long time and not only us. There is no manager there, the staff served tables chaotically and could not keep up, could not even refill wine or water, and we waited 90 minutes for food. * 2 nights · May 2026 * Family

Excellent hotel. Very good and kind service. Comfortable and modern facilities. Excellent bathroom. Wonderful location. The breakfast was a little confused and slow. The food was excellent but it seemed the team was not aligned and flowing well. I had to chase some orders and there was not the organisation I expected from this hotel. * 2 nights · May 2026 * Couple
Everything was perfect. * 1 night · May 2026 * Couple
